'''Merg Thando''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Gramm Rile]] sent a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find him.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Merg Thando]]
Merg Thando was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older quests in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]], gender, and appearance of Merg Thando changed each time a player performed this quest. Species that Thando could appear as included, but were not necessarily limited to, [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]]. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the [[canon]]ical species of Thando. However, the quest dialogue given by Gramm Rile indicated that Merg Thando was a [[Gender/Legends|male]].
